_comment: Shape of the env store's config.json (one per machine, never in git). Every key is read by a skill or engine script; keep the shape, change the values. Blank one: `kb.py init --blank`; set values: `kb.py config-set <dotted.key> <value>`; checklist: docs/new-environment.md.

tracker.kind: jira | github | none — kit_profile.py's TRACKER_KINDS is the enum; kit-verify rejects any other value
tracker.site: <jira site host, e.g. acme.atlassian.net — jira only>
tracker.board_sprint_prefix: <sprint name prefix to match on, jira only, or empty>
tracker.sprint_field: <customfield_… for Sprint — jira only, or empty>
tracker.unplanned_field: <customfield_… for the Unplanned flag — jira only, or empty>
repos: <owner/repo tracked with GitHub issues — github only>
tracker.key_regex: <regex with ONE capture group matching a ticket key in free text; jira: \b((?:KEY)-\d+)\b — github: (?:^|[^\w/])#(\d+)\b>

mcp_tools.search: <… the tracker's issue-search tool, used by cost-report and a single-ticket lookup by key (JQL `key = <KEY>`)>
mcp_tools.edit: <… the generic issue-edit tool, e.g. setting a resolution field>
mcp_tools.transitions_list: <… the tool that lists the transitions actually available on an issue (ids drift)>
mcp_tools.remote_link: <… the read-only tool that lists an issue's remote links>

github.org: <github org or user the team's repos live under>
github.review_bot: <login of the AI review bot that posts a verdict on PRs, or empty>
github.sandbox_token_prefix: <e.g. GH_TOKEN=dummy when a sandbox proxy injects the real token; empty otherwise>
owner_teams: <CODEOWNERS teams whose review requests count as yours>

datalake._comment: kind: warehouse vendor (snowflake | bigquery | …) — selects the datalake-<vendor> discovery manifest; empty when systems.datalake is false.

diagrams._comment: repos.<owner/repo>.facets.<facet>: [globs] and .ignore: [globs] — per-repo overlays for pr-open's diagram-plan.py; overlay wins over the core defaults. Optional.

commits._comment: default: conventional | ticket-key | free (kit default conventional); repos.<owner/repo>: per-repo override, set as one object with `kb.py config-set commits '{…}'`. A repo's own .claude/commit-style marker or commitlint config wins. Spec: docs/commit-style.md.

self_assessment.scope: <one sentence: what work counts in this environment>

cost._comment: cost-report skill; optional (absent = private mode). spend_table/email/filters/columns: the warehouse spend table at grain user × model × day (org mode, needs systems.datalake); extra_repos: owner/repo outside github.org that count as the user's work; phases: named before/after windows. Set as one object with `kb.py config-set cost '{…}'`.
cost.email: <the user's email as it appears in spend_table>
cost.filters: <SQL predicate selecting the Claude Code rows, or "" for none>
extra_repos: <owner/repo outside github.org, e.g. the kit repo>

kit._comment: Written by setup.sh, never by hand (#34): how the kit is installed on this machine — kit_profile.install_mode(). kit-health § 1 warns when the kit it runs from is installed another way (re-run setup.sh). Optional: absent until setup.sh has run. `sandbox_markers` is set by hand, optional (#94): absolute paths or variable names whose presence means this machine runs in a sandbox, so kit-health warns when github.sandbox_token_prefix is empty there; absent or [] = no sandbox check.
